quarterly_data.signal: MYR Group investor presentation (8-K): trailing-twelve-month figures at June 30, 2026 - revenue $4.01B (T&D $2.10B, C&I $1.91B), net income $165.3M, diluted EPS $10.54, EBITDA $293.4M, free cash flow $193.4M and capital expenditures $105.1M; the company has ~10,000 employees and 70+ office locations.
quarterly_data.figure: LTM revenue $4.01B; EBITDA $293.4M; free cash flow $193.4M

quarterly_data.signal: MYR Group investor presentation (8-K) outlook: 'AI is driving growth in data centers and power demand. Data centers have been an important and growing end market for our C&I segment for a long time, while new interconnections, substations and infrastructure upgrades to data centers present additional opportunities for our T&D segment'; the T&D segment builds and upgrades lines and substations to interconnect new data centers for its utility customers; C&I core markets remain active with notable strength in data center and transportation opportunities, and reshoring of manufacturing continues to create opportunities in both segments.

MYR Group investor presentation (8-K): the Valley Electric Company (founded 1982, Everett, Washington) and Comet Electric (founded 1976, Chatsworth, California) acquisition closed on July 1, 2026; the C&I contractors have combined annual revenues in excess of $400 million (2024-2025), more than 900 employees and six office locations in Washington and California, serving customers in WA, CA, OR, ID and NV.
quarterly_data.figure: combined annual revenues in excess of $400 million
